description: This file defines the class ExistsThingPredicateVisitor, which implements the ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor interface for Java Predicates over Things, providing methods to visit different types of expressions and generate corresponding Predicate<Thing> objects.

classes.name: ExistsThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: Final class implementing ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor for generating Predicates over Thing instances.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that takes an ExistsFieldExpression and returns a Predicate<Thing> by accepting a new ExistsThingPredicateVisitor.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Generates a Predicate<Thing> that checks if a specified attribute key exists within the Thing's attributes.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Generates a Predicate<Thing> that checks if a specific feature ID exists within the Thing's features.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a Predicate<Thing> to verify the existence of a specific property within a given feature ID.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Creates a Predicate<Thing> that checks if the JSON representation of the Thing contains a specified field.
